summary: Prudential plc furnished a routine Form 6-K disclosing PDMR share dealings under its All Employee Share Purchase Plan. CFO Ben Bulmer bought 42 ordinary shares at GBP 9.899362 on 2026-09-10; CHRO Catherine Chia bought 38; Chief Risk and Compliance Officer Avnish Kalra bought 42; Eastspring CEO Rajeev Mittal also participated per the excerpt. All trades occurred on the London Stock Exchange at the same plan price. No stake, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction structure is stated. This is an ordinary insider-dealing notification, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
